title: Apply for a Maritime Security Identification Card (MSIC)
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a Maritime Security Identification Card (MSIC).
who_can_apply: port facility or port service worker
seafarer on a security regulated ship
work on and/or supply to offshore oil and gas facilities
what_you_need: The MSIC is valid for either 2 or 4 years.
It is recommended to apply at least 6 weeks before you need the MSIC.

how_to_steps.text: Go to AusCheck Apply for a Maritime Security Identification Card (MSIC) .
